issue-canvaskit.md:
### Scope

The reproduction uses full hot restart, which starts the Dart application again while retaining the browser page. Stateful hot reload keeps the running renderer and does not invoke `ext.flutter.disassemble`. PR #196786 also changes shared surface disposal and canvas replacement, including resize-recovery paths; a hot-reload leak or performance benefit has not been measured here.

Source: [restart cleanup hook](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/22e676c57e1e6d04c2289a47368ea4093bbc3c18/engine/src/flutter/lib/web_ui/lib/src/engine/initialization.dart#L149), [renderer registration](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/3e25df705b11935d0a4a5750e6b8bc26460877b1/engine/src/flutter/lib/web_ui/lib/src/engine/canvaskit/renderer.dart#L76), [shared surface release](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/3e25df705b11935d0a4a5750e6b8bc26460877b1/engine/src/flutter/lib/web_ui/lib/src/engine/canvaskit/surface.dart#L269).
issue-listener.md:
### Scope

The reproduction uses full hot restart, which replaces the web engine dispatcher. Stateful hot reload updates code while retaining the existing dispatcher. PR #196787 fixes dispatcher disposal generally; disposing an app widget is a different operation. These measurements do not demonstrate a stateful-hot-reload leak.

Source: [dispatcher restart registration and disposal](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/b8bbc80b12474d54da242a2e150c6fd6d8dbde9c/engine/src/flutter/lib/web_ui/lib/src/engine/platform_dispatcher.dart#L37), [engine restart cleanup](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/22e676c57e1e6d04c2289a47368ea4093bbc3c18/engine/src/flutter/lib/web_ui/lib/src/engine/initialization.dart#L149).
issue-ddc.md:
### Scope

This affects canary hot restart that replaces the Dart runtime. Stateful hot reload updates existing library objects and does not call `disposeNativeExtensions()`. Both the retention measurements and the callback error described below were reproduced after hot restart, not stateful hot reload. The legacy AMD restart path and dart2js/dart2wasm release builds use different runtimes.

Source: [DDC loader change and restart cleanup calls](https://dart-review.googlesource.com/c/sdk/+/578301/3/pkg/dev_compiler/lib/js/ddc/ddc_module_loader.js).
